title: rosa rubella var. mediterranea
intro: Rosa rubella var. mediterranea, commonly known as the Mediterranean Rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the rose family, known for its fragrant and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rosa rubella var. mediterranea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against oxidative stress. Therapeutically, Rosa rubella var. mediterranea is used to treat various conditions, including menstrual disorders, anxiety, and insomnia, due to its sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of Rosa rubella var. mediterranea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
